envelope.description: Verify review evidence policy and focused compatibility

body.title: Verify review evidence policy and focused compatibility
body.summary: Complete shared prompt/result-policy fixtures and focused first-attempt failure/compatibility checks. Cover meaningful implementation, test coverage and target-convention evidence in both reviewer routes; do not expand into coding or build-validation changes, coverage instrumentation or broad live benchmarks.
acceptanceChecks: Body-only regressions require implementation evidence; missing graph/run records and unsupported verification remain limitations, not fabricated HIGH/MED or false pass.
Passing files with unused helpers do not prove executed assertions. Revision-mismatched test results cannot establish reviewed behavior.

Review fixtures cover Python/JS/TS/Go/JVM conventions/verification limits, encapsulation and responsibility boundaries, readability extremes, local/fallback naming and approved-framework/native fallback; optional taste/framework advice does not request changes. These are focused review-input/result fixtures, not a language execution benchmark or new test adapters.

Shared prompt and result normalization apply equivalently across daemon/controller and supported planned/standalone/bugfix entrypoints; no separate coding/build validation adapter changes are included.

Affected backend/provider/CR regression checks and production build pass. Preserve early actual live evidence unless a changed prerequisite or failure requires a targeted rerun; no repeated broad model sweep, automatic extra review rounds or legacy-engine deletion.

tests.name: review evidence policy: body-only logic, missing graph/run evidence and unused test-helper coverage
review quality policy: target-language conventions, encapsulation/readability/naming and approved/native framework fallback
review policy parity: common prompt/result classification across supported routes without coding/build-validation changes
deployable task review: production build and affected provider/backend/CR regressions with legacy/design routing preserved
